name: feishu-pro
description: 飞书通讯录与云文档工作台（**lark-cli 驱动**：凭证与接口交给官方 CLI，文档正文走 docs +fetch → markdown 富文本渲染；通讯录 / 会话 / 发送 / 私聊定位 / 私聊提醒也全部走 CLI；**自建凭证链（App 注册 / OAuth / token 续期）已删除**）：接入走 lark-cli 官方设备码（配置应用 / 登录账号都在浏览器完成，零手工 App ID）/ **会话列表（左列表 + 右消息视图：可读、可发文本、可一键加入监听；发送身份可切“我 / 机器人”，并检测缺哪些 scope）** / **通讯录行内直接私聊或跳飞书** / 按关键词与部门查同事 / **最近访问**（按飞书身份分桶的本地记录：访问/创建/最后修改时间三显示，共用实例上互不可见）/ 我的空间（按修改或创建时间排序）/ 知识库（个人身份）/ 云文档搜索与阅读 / **私聊提醒（轮询增量：从最新往回取一段（降序 3×50）、首次静默建基线、自己发的不报、本地未读徽标）** / **open_id → 私聊 chat_id 解析（不发消息）** / 发送 scope 体检 / **会话读写（列会话 / 读最近消息 / 发文本：可切「我 / 机器人」身份，带幂等键）** / **私聊自动问答（可选开启：轮询新消息 → 跑一轮 agent → 以我/机器人身份回包，带白名单/冷却/限频，空跑模式可先只看不发）** / AI feishu_pro 工具。与原 feishu 插件完全独立 / **AI 待办（「待办」页签：本地待办库 + 飞书任务双向同步（新建可选同步飞书 / 编辑即 PATCH 回写）+ 后台定时自动同步与自动提取候选（默认关、15/30/60 分钟可选）+ AI 逐条给处理建议 + 一键让 AI 自动处理；发送类动作先看草稿二次确认，其余直接执行）**
descriptionEn: Feishu contacts & cloud-doc workbench (lark-cli backed: credentials & APIs via the official CLI, docs rendered from +fetch markdown): onboarding via the official lark-cli device-code flow (no manual App ID), chat list (threaded read view, text sending as user or bot, one-click watch), contact search by keyword/department, doc search & reader, drive + wiki browsing, DM alerts (incremental polling: silent first baseline, strictly advancing watermark, never your own messages), chat discovery, IM history reading and text sending (as the user or the bot, with idempotency keys), optional DM auto-reply (poll new messages, run one agent turn, answer as the user or bot; allowlist, cooldown, hourly cap, dry-run), and the feishu_pro AI tool. Fully independent from the original feishu plugin. / AI to-dos (a dedicated tab: a local to-do store with two-way Feishu Tasks sync (optional remote task on create, PATCH write-back on edit), an opt-in background job that periodically pulls Feishu tasks and extracts candidates from watched chats, per-item AI advice, one-click AI handling — outbound messages are shown as a draft for confirmation first)
author: pi-web-ui
